content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing.

- Regarding the clause "$ 115,250.00      Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date of this Agreement.", the current payment terms of Net 90 days create cash flow delays for your business. I propose modifying this so that the client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

Please let me know if these adjustments work for you.

Best regards,
